Johann Botha Murder Accused Court Update

By: Laura Byrne | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We update you on the ongoing investigation into the murder of producer Johann Botha.

Unique Selling Point:
As the Carte Blanche team continues to come to terms with the sudden loss of one of our own, the police investigation into his murder is ongoing. Three of the five suspects have been arrested and appeared in Johannesburg Magistrate's Court on charges of double murder, possession of firearms, and armed robbery. We cover their second appearance in court and continue to follow this case, hoping to see justice done.

Summary:
The three suspects were reportedly arrested on the evening of Tuesday 13 June and had their first court appearance on Thursday 15 June, when the case was postponed to Thursday 22 June. According to Investigating Officer Wiseman Sephungu, this postponement was in order to arrange an identity parade and arrange legal representation for the three suspects. On 22 June it emerged that identity parades had been completed with all but one witness; and the purpose of Thursday 22nd's court appearance was to introduce the suspects' attorneys. The case was remanded for a bail hearing on 7 July, which will take place in Court 13 at the Magistrate's Court.

Further information:
There are reports that the suspects were arrested using cctv imagery; however, police refused to confirm this as it is part of their case against the suspects. It was confirmed that there are 5 suspects, not 4. The robbers fled the scene with one firearm (not 2) as well as an undisclosed amount of cash.

Suspects appearing on Thursday: Nkosiyazi Phungula, Ntobeko Hlatswayo and Thembi Mbatha
CAS number: 130/06/17

Note that we did not interview anyone for this update. Facts were confirmed telephonically in a conversation with Investigating Officer Colonel Wiseman Sephungu. Tony, Laura and Sinethemba attended the court appearance in an attempt to get footage of the suspects but our application to film was denied. We will be launching a full application to film bail proceedings on 7 July.

Script:


JOHANN BOTHA MURDER INVESTIGATION UPDATE

The life of Carte Blanche producer and popular radio and television personality, Johann Botha, was tragically cut short on Wednesday 7 June. Botha and his friend Werner ‘Swazi’ Perchtold were victims of an armed robbery at Perchtold’s Zebra Inn, in Maboneng.

According to police, five suspects, four men and a woman, entered the bar, ordered a drink, then shot Botha and Perchtold before fleeing with a firearm and cash.

On Tuesday 13 June two men and a woman were arrested. They are 27 year-old Nkosiyazi Phungula, 32 year-old Ntobeko Hlatswayo, both arrested in Melville, and 19 year-old Thembi Masethembe Mbatha arrested in KwaZulu Natal.

That Thursday, as family and friends gathered to memorialise Johann, all three suspects appeared in the Johannesburg Magistrate’s Court on charges of double murder, armed robbery and illegal possession of firearms. After an identity parade was conducted, the suspects appeared in court again this week with their legal representatives.

The case has been postponed to 7 July, for a bail hearing. The three will remain in custody until then but a fourth and fifth suspect are still at large.
